==================
Single-line From Select
==================

Class C
    Sub Main()
        Dim r = From x In items Select x
    End Sub
End Class

==================
Qualified source expression
==================

Class C
    Sub Main()
        Dim sections = From section In Subject.Split(",")
                       Where section.Contains("CN")
                       Select section
    End Sub
End Class

==================
Order By ascending and descending
==================

Class C
    Sub Main()
        Dim r = From x In items
                Order By x.Name Ascending, x.Age Descending
                Select x
    End Sub
End Class

==================
Let clause
==================

==================

==================

==================
Join clause
==================

Class C
    Sub Main()
        Dim pairs = From a In listA
                    Join b In listB On a.Id Equals b.Id
                    Select a, b
    End Sub

==================
Group Join clause
==================

Class C
    Sub Main()
        Dim result = From c In customers
                     Group Join o In orders On c.Id Equals o.CustomerId Into orderGroup = Group
                     Select c, orderGroup
    End Sub
End Class

==================
Group By clause
==================

Class C
    Sub Main()
        Dim totals = From o In orders
                     Group o By o.CustomerId Into orderGroup = Group, total = Sum(o.Amount)
                     Select CustomerId, total
    End Sub
End Class

==================

==================

==================
Aggregate with nested Where and multiple Into items
==================

Class C
    Sub Main()
        Dim stats = Aggregate o In orders
                    Where o.IsValid
                    Into count = Count(), avg = Average(o.Amount)
    End Sub
End Class

==================
Named Select projection
==================

Class C
    Sub Main()
        Dim r = From c In customers
                Select Name = c.FirstName & " " & c.LastName, Email = c.EmailAddress
    End Sub
End Class

==================

==================

        Dim r = (From x In items Select x).ToList()
    End Sub
End Class
